name: screenshot-features
title: Screenshot features
description: A big framed product screenshot with three or four feature columns underneath, each tied to what you can see above.
docs: Pass title (and optionally eyebrow and description), screenshot (src, alt, width, height and a title for the window's bar) and features (a title and a description each, with an optional href and marker). The screenshot sits full width in a window frame with a hairline border and a title bar with three quiet dots. The frame takes its proportions from width and height before the picture loads, blurDataUrl is a tiny picture that stands in blurred until it arrives, sizes tells the browser how wide it is shown, and the picture is lazy unless you set priority because the section is above the fold. Pass renderImage to use next/image. The alt text should describe the screen in one sentence. Give a feature a marker (x and y as percentages of the screenshot) and its number is drawn on the picture where the feature lives, matching the number of its column; the marks are decoration, sized from the picture so that on a phone they shrink with it, and each belongs on empty canvas beside what it points at. The columns are an ordered list and stack under 768px while the screenshot stays full width; four features sit two by two before four across. Nothing animates. labels translates the link and the name of the list.
